name: Toronto Pearson International Airport
description: Source-backed GTAA configuration for Terminal 1, Terminal 3 and the Infield Concourse, with user-ready stands and a synthetic demand baseline. Not operationally approved.

spatial_reference.reference_source: User-confirmed red airport pin in alignment overview before cropping, not the cropped PDF page or embedded screenshot centre.
spatial_reference.source_diagram_coordinates: PDF points, native page origin bottom-left and y increasing upward; label positions only, not stand centres.

assumptions: 166 stands and 147 gates have approximate georeferenced map-label coordinates for visualization only, not aircraft parking points or gate doors. T1 193 and IFC 528A retain explicit airport-reference placeholders. Absolute horizontal accuracy is unverified; do not use any of these positions for routing, distance, capacity or clearance calculations.

All 168 stands are user-configured as ready for stand-rule evaluation. This does not certify geographic accuracy, simultaneous capacity, source reconciliation or manual procedures; planning_ready and routing_ready remain false.
Exterior stand identifiers and interior passenger gates are different resources. Map label proximity suggests associations for review; shared gates do not establish gate capacities.

Contact values, arrival/departure sector groups, airline authorizations and explicit stand availability are user-configured. Passenger gate associations and unverified passenger levels still require review.
ASM aircraft permissions use a GTAA-specific exact-variant catalog with user-added IATA codes. IATA codes do not merge distinct ASM variants.

The user approved copying Contoso's synthetic demo handling windows, 12-minute default tow duration and hourly traffic weights. These are test assumptions, not verified GTAA operating figures; traffic weights use America/Toronto local time and do not specify total flight volume.

ASM exact aircraft variants and per-leg permissions are translated separately from manual stopline, VDGS, bridge, GPU, ramp and spotter requirements. An assignment does not establish that those procedures are satisfied.

Stand-level and aircraft-conditioned closures and supported neighbor restrictions are encoded with source references. Ambiguous source aircraft tokens and B737-500-or-smaller ordering remain explicit review requirements in asm-rules.json.
Maps and ASM documents have different dates. Map-only and ASM-only stands remain explicit reconciliation items; absence does not prove a stand is open or closed.
Empty infrastructure and routing collections mean not yet modelled, not that those facilities do not exist. Revisions and general notes are not current stand permissions.
